source.role: Shared library that resolves, creates and looks up periodic (daily/weekly/monthly/quarterly/yearly) notes; used by obsidian-calendar-plugin and, historically, obsidian-periodic-notes.

modules.name: index.ts
modules.role: Public API surface: re-exports per-granularity functions/constants, generic create/get-settings dispatchers, and inline plugin-detection functions for daily/weekly notes.

modules.name: constants.ts
modules.role: Default moment format strings per granularity.

modules.name: types.ts
modules.role: Shared IGranularity union and IPeriodicNoteSettings shape.

modules.name: settings.ts
modules.role: Reads per-granularity note settings out of the periodic-notes plugin, the core daily-notes plugin, or the Calendar plugin, with fallback defaults.

modules.name: daily.ts
modules.role: Create/lookup/enumerate daily notes; mustache template token replacement including date/time math and {{yesterday}}/{{tomorrow}}.

modules.name: weekly.ts
modules.role: Create/lookup/enumerate weekly notes; locale-aware day-of-week resolution and {{sunday|monday|...:format}} template tokens.

modules.name: parse.ts
modules.role: Maps a filename/path back to a Moment for a given granularity (strict then optional prefix match); builds the dateUID cache key.

modules.name: vault.ts
modules.role: Path join/basename utilities, folder auto-creation, and template file loading (with Obsidian fold-state).

modules.name: Obsidian core API
modules.role: App/Vault/TFile/TFolder/normalizePath/Notice/metadataCache/foldManager — the host app surface this library reads and writes.

modules.name: Periodic Notes community plugin
modules.role: Community plugin instance read via app.plugins.getPlugin('periodic-notes-anks' | 'periodic-notes'); source of per-granularity settings.{daily,weekly,monthly,quarterly,yearly}.

modules.name: Calendar community plugin
modules.role: Community plugin instance read via app.plugins.getPlugin('calendar-anks' | 'calendar'); source of legacy weekly-note settings (.options.weeklyNoteFormat/Folder/Template) and of weekly-notes-enabled detection.

modules.name: Obsidian core 'daily-notes' internal plugin
modules.role: Obsidian's built-in daily notes plugin, read via app.internalPlugins.plugins['daily-notes'] / internalPlugins.getPluginById('daily-notes').instance.options.

capabilities.name: Create a daily note
capabilities.description: Creates a new daily note file for a given Moment: resolves settings, applies the configured template (with fold state), fills in filename/date/time tokens, writes the file via vault.create, and returns the created TFile.
behaviour_notes: Mimics the core daily-notes plugin's mustache replacement so behavior stays in sync.
Restores Obsidian fold state on the new file via app.foldManager.save(createdFile, IFoldInfo) (src/daily.ts:65).
Does not check for an existing file before calling vault.create; relies on vault.create throwing.

On any failure (including 'file already exists'), logs to console, shows a generic Notice('Unable to create new file.'), and the function resolves to undefined instead of rejecting or returning null (src/daily.ts:68-71).
edge_cases: shows error if file creation failed (src/__tests__/daily.spec.ts pattern shared across granularities)
replaces all mustaches in template, including {{date+1d:format}}-style calc tokens

capabilities.name: Look up a daily note by date
capabilities.description: Given a Moment and a Record<dateUID, TFile> (as produced by getAllDailyNotes), returns the matching TFile or null.
behaviour_notes: Pure lookup keyed by getDateUID(date, 'day'); does not touch the vault itself.
Because getDateUID calls date.clone().startOf('day'), time-of-day differences on the lookup Moment do not affect the match.
edge_cases: returns note on the same day even if the HH:MM:SS is different
returns null if there is no daily note for a given date

capabilities.name: Enumerate all daily notes
capabilities.description: Recursively walks the configured daily-notes folder and returns a Record<dateUID, TFile> for every file whose name parses as a valid daily-note date.
behaviour_notes: Unlike getAllWeeklyNotes/getAllMonthlyNotes/getAllQuarterlyNotes/getAllYearlyNotes, this function does NOT call appHasDailyNotesPluginLoaded() first — it always attempts the folder lookup.
Throws DailyNotesFolderMissingError if the configured folder does not exist (vault.getAbstractFileByPath returns falsy).
edge_cases: throws error if daily note folder can't be found
returns a list of all daily notes with no nested folders
returns a list of all daily notes including files nested in folders

capabilities.name: Create a weekly note
capabilities.description: Creates a new weekly note file for a given Moment, applying the template plus weekly-specific {{sunday|monday|...:format}} tokens in addition to the shared date/time/title tokens.
behaviour_notes: Does not support {{yesterday}}/{{tomorrow}} tokens (daily-only).
Same 'no existing-file check, generic Notice on failure' pattern as createDailyNote (src/weekly.ts:81-84).
edge_cases: replaces {{sunday}} and {{monday}} in weekly note
shows error if file creation failed

capabilities.name: Look up a weekly note by date

behaviour_notes: Same shape as getDailyNote/getMonthlyNote/etc.

capabilities.name: Enumerate all weekly notes
capabilities.description: If weekly notes are enabled (Calendar or Periodic Notes plugin), recursively walks the configured weekly folder and returns a Record<dateUID, TFile>.
behaviour_notes: Guarded: returns {} immediately if appHasWeeklyNotesPluginLoaded() is false, unlike getAllDailyNotes which has no such guard.
Throws WeeklyNotesFolderMissingError if the folder is missing (only reachable when the plugin check passed).
edge_cases: throws error if weekly note folder can't be found
returns a list of all weekly notes including files nested in folders

behaviour_notes: Identical structure/error-handling to createQuarterlyNote and createYearlyNote.

capabilities.name: Generic create-note dispatcher
capabilities.description: Dispatches to the correct create*Note function for a given IGranularity + Moment.
behaviour_notes: BUG: the internal dispatch table only has keys 'day', 'month', 'week' (src/index.ts:118-122); 'quarter' and 'year' are missing.

Calling createPeriodicNote('quarter', date) or createPeriodicNote('year', date) evaluates createFn['quarter'] to undefined and throws a TypeError ('createFn[granularity] is not a function') rather than delegating to createQuarterlyNote/createYearlyNote, even though both exist and are separately exported.
edge_cases: No test coverage found for this function (not present in any __tests__ spec).

capabilities.name: Generic settings dispatcher
capabilities.description: Dispatches to the correct getXNoteSettings function for a given IGranularity and returns IPeriodicNoteSettings.
behaviour_notes: Unlike createPeriodicNote, this dispatch table is complete for all 5 granularities.

capabilities.name: Resolve daily note settings
capabilities.description: Returns {format, folder, template} for daily notes, preferring the Periodic Notes plugin's daily settings (if enabled) over the core daily-notes internal plugin's options, with DEFAULT_DAILY_NOTE_FORMAT / '' fallbacks.
behaviour_notes: Wraps everything in try/catch; on error logs via console.info('No custom daily note settings found!', err) and returns undefined (not a default object) — callers destructuring the result will throw.
Never includes allowPrefixMatch in the returned object.
edge_cases: returns defaults if daily note settings don't exist
uses settings from core daily notes if periodic-notes' daily is disabled
uses settings from Periodic Notes if periodic-notes and daily notes are both enabled
cleanses data (trims folder/template whitespace)

capabilities.name: Resolve weekly note settings

behaviour_notes: The only one of the five getXNoteSettings functions that ever populates allowPrefixMatch — and only when the Periodic Notes plugin's weekly settings are in effect.
When falling back to the Calendar plugin, allowPrefixMatch is hardcoded to false with an explicit comment 'Calendar plugin doesn't support this setting' (src/settings.ts:92).
edge_cases: returns defaults if weekly note settings don't exist
cleanses data

capabilities.name: Periodic-Notes-settings precedence check
capabilities.description: Returns true when the Periodic Notes plugin is installed and its settings[periodicity].enabled flag is truthy, gating whether a resolve-*-settings function reads from Periodic Notes vs. its legacy fallback.
behaviour_notes: Not exported from index.ts; internal to settings.ts only.

capabilities.name: Resolve the Periodic Notes plugin instance (dev-id first)
capabilities.description: Looks up the Periodic Notes plugin instance via app.plugins.getPlugin, trying the side-loaded dev build id 'periodic-notes-anks' first and falling back to the community-store id 'periodic-notes'.
behaviour_notes: Order is always: 'periodic-notes-anks' (dev/side-installed build) then 'periodic-notes' (community store build) — first truthy wins.

Imported by index.ts and called directly from appHasMonthlyNotesPluginLoaded/appHasQuarterlyNotesPluginLoaded/appHasYearlyNotesPluginLoaded (src/index.ts:52,57,62), but is NOT itself re-exported from index.ts's public export block (src/index.ts:127-149) — it is reachable only indirectly, through the boolean/settings functions that call it.

appHasDailyNotesPluginLoaded and appHasWeeklyNotesPluginLoaded do NOT call this function — they re-implement the same 'anks id first, then production id' probe inline in index.ts (see observations: duplication).

capabilities.name: Detect whether daily notes are enabled
capabilities.description: Returns true if Obsidian's core 'daily-notes' internal plugin is enabled, OR if the Periodic Notes plugin (dev id 'periodic-notes-anks' checked before 'periodic-notes') is installed with settings.daily.enabled truthy.
behaviour_notes: Checks app.internalPlugins.plugins['daily-notes'].enabled FIRST; only checks Periodic Notes if that internal plugin is absent/disabled.
Duplicates detect-periodic-notes-plugin's dev-id-first lookup inline instead of calling getPeriodicNotesPlugin() (src/index.ts:22-24).
Not called by getAllDailyNotes (see observation on daily's missing guard).
edge_cases: returns true when daily notes plugin is enabled
returns false when the core plugin is disabled and Periodic Notes' daily is not enabled

capabilities.name: Detect whether weekly notes are enabled
capabilities.description: Returns true if the Calendar plugin (dev id 'calendar-anks' checked before 'calendar') is installed, OR if the Periodic Notes plugin (dev id first) is installed with settings.weekly.enabled truthy.
behaviour_notes: Presence of the Calendar plugin alone is sufficient — its settings.weekly.enabled is never checked, unlike the other four granularities.
Duplicates detect-periodic-notes-plugin's dev-id-first lookup inline (src/index.ts:45-47) instead of calling getPeriodicNotesPlugin().
Code comment (src/index.ts:28-31) explains: weekly notes historically lived in the Calendar plugin and are checked there until that feature is fully migrated to Periodic Notes.
edge_cases: returns true when weekly notes plugin is enabled
returns false when weekly notes plugin is disabled

capabilities.name: Detect whether monthly notes are enabled
capabilities.description: Returns true only if the Periodic Notes plugin is installed and settings.monthly.enabled is truthy. There is no legacy/core plugin fallback for monthly notes.
behaviour_notes: Delegates cleanly to getPeriodicNotesPlugin(), unlike the daily/weekly variants.
edge_cases: returns true when periodic-notes plugin is enabled
returns false when periodic-notes plugin is disabled

returns false when periodic-notes plugin is disabled

capabilities.name: Parse a note's date from its filename
capabilities.description: Given a TFile (getDateFromFile) or a path string (getDateFromPath) plus a granularity, resolves that granularity's format and parses the basename into a Moment, first strictly, then (only if allowPrefixMatch is set) via loose/prefix matching. Returns null if nothing matches.
behaviour_notes: format is taken as settings.format.split('/').pop() — only the last path segment of the configured format is used for parsing (handles formats with folder-like separators).
Step 1: strict moment(filename, format, true). If valid, checked for 'ambiguity' (see below); returned as-is otherwise.

isFormatAmbiguous (src/parse.ts:36-45) only fires for granularity==='week' when the (bracket-stripped) format contains a week-number token (w/ww) AND also a month (M) or day (D) token. In that case the date is re-parsed non-strictly with M/D tokens stripped from the format, because moment prioritizes month+day over week-number when both are present, which is wrong for a week-numbered filename.
Step 2 (only if strict parse failed): if allowPrefixMatch is falsy, returns null immediately.

Step 2b: otherwise re-parses non-strictly, then re-formats the parsed moment with the same format and requires filename.startsWith(formattedDate) before accepting — this lets a filename with a descriptive suffix (e.g. '2025-W46, 10.11 - 16.11') still resolve to the same date as the strict prefix.

allowPrefixMatch only ever comes from resolve-weekly-settings (Periodic Notes weekly settings); the other four resolve-*-settings functions never set it, so day/month/quarter/year notes can never use prefix matching in this codebase even though the code path is generic.
edge_cases: it supports formats with year, month, and day
it supports formats with partial year, month, and week number
it supports formats with year and week number
it supports formats with year, week number, and month
it supports formats with year, week number, and day
it supports formats with year, month number, week number
it supports formats with year, month number, week number without prefix
it supports year, month, day, week number
[en-gb] it supports year, month, day, week number

ambiguous dates are still parsed strictly first — a filename with an extra suffix or spaces is rejected (null), not loosely matched, when the base strict format cannot match it and allowPrefixMatch isn't in play for that variant

capabilities.name: Compute a granularity-prefixed date UID
capabilities.description: Given a Moment and granularity (default 'day'), returns a string like 'day-2026-09-08T00:00:00-04:00' — the date is normalized with startOf(granularity) first, and the granularity name is prefixed to avoid cross-granularity collisions.
behaviour_notes: Clones the input Moment before calling startOf(), so it does not mutate the caller's date object.
edge_cases: it does not mutate the original date
it uses 'day' for the default granularity
it supports 'week'/'month' granularity

capabilities.name: Resolve a day-of-week name to its locale-relative index
capabilities.description: Given a day name ('sunday'..'saturday'), returns its index (0-6) relative to the current moment locale's configured week-start day, used to implement weekly template tokens like {{monday:...}}.
behaviour_notes: Reads moment.localeData()._week.dow directly (private Moment API) to determine the locale's week start, then rotates a fixed Sun-Sat array by that many positions.
edge_cases: start week on Sunday: returns 0 for sunday, 1 for monday
start week on Monday: returns 6 for sunday, 0 for monday

capabilities.name: Load a template file's contents and fold state
capabilities.description: Given a template path, returns a tuple [contents, IFoldInfo]. Returns ['', null] immediately if the (normalized) template path is empty ('/'); otherwise reads the file via metadataCache.getFirstLinkpathDest + vault.cachedRead and loads its fold state via app.foldManager.load.
behaviour_notes: Errors (e.g. template file not found -> metadataCache.getFirstLinkpathDest returns null -> vault.cachedRead(null) throws) are caught internally: logs to console.error, shows Notice('Failed to read the daily note template'), and resolves to ['', null] rather than rejecting.
This means a misconfigured/missing template silently degrades to an empty-body note instead of failing the create-*-note call.
edge_cases: returns '' if path is empty
returns contents of the template file
throws error if file can't be found (caught internally; resolves to empty tuple with a Notice rather than propagating)

capabilities.name: Build a normalized note path and create its parent folder
capabilities.description: Given a target directory and filename, appends '.md' if missing, joins+normalizes the path, and creates any missing parent folder(s) via vault.createFolder before returning the final path.
behaviour_notes: ensureFolderExists only checks/creates the immediate parent directory (join of all but the last path segment); it does not recursively verify each intermediate ancestor exists — relies on Obsidian's vault.createFolder to handle nested creation.
join() is a vendored mini path.join implementation (credited to @creationix/path.js) — no dependency on Node's `path` module, so it works in Obsidian's sandboxed/mobile runtime.
edge_cases: join() mimics path.join

capabilities.name: {{date}}/{{time}} template tokens with optional +/-N unit offset and custom format
capabilities.description: Regex-driven mustache replacement supporting {{date}}, {{time}}, {{date+7d}}, {{date-1M:YYYY-MM}}, etc. — applies a time-of-day from 'now' onto the note's date, optionally offsets by a signed integer + unit (y/q/m/w/d/h/s), and optionally formats with a custom moment format after the trailing ':'.
behaviour_notes: The exact same regex and callback body (byte-for-byte) is duplicated across all five create*Note functions instead of being a shared helper — a prime de-duplication target for the merge (see observations).
Falls back to the granularity's own `format` (not a fixed default) when no custom momentFormat is supplied after ':'.
edge_cases: replaces all mustaches in template (each granularity's own spec file)

capabilities.name: {{yesterday}}/{{tomorrow}} template tokens (daily only)
capabilities.description: In createDailyNote only, replaces {{yesterday}} and {{tomorrow}} with the note's date minus/plus one day, formatted with the daily format.
behaviour_notes: No equivalent token exists for weekly/monthly/quarterly/yearly notes — this is a daily-only feature, an asymmetry worth deciding on during the merge.

capabilities.name: {{sunday|monday|...:format}} template tokens (weekly only)
capabilities.description: In createWeeklyNote only, replaces {{<dayname>:<format>}} with that day of the note's week (via date.weekday(n)), formatted with the given moment format.
behaviour_notes: Requires an explicit ':<format>' suffix (regex requires the colon and a format group); '{{monday}}' alone does not match this token.
edge_cases: replaces {{sunday}} and {{monday}} in weekly note

settings.label: Daily note date format (core plugin)
settings.notes: Read from internalPlugins.getPluginById('daily-notes').instance.options.format; used only when Periodic Notes' daily settings are not in effect.

settings.label: Allow loose/prefix matching of weekly note filenames

api_surface.signature: { folder?: string; format?: string; template?: string; allowPrefixMatch?: boolean }

observations.what: index.ts's generic createPeriodicNote(granularity, date) dispatch table only maps 'day', 'month', 'week' to their create functions; 'quarter' and 'year' are absent even though createQuarterlyNote/createYearlyNote both exist and are separately exported.
observations.why_it_matters: Any merged code path that routes through the generic dispatcher (rather than calling create*Note directly) will throw a TypeError for quarter/year instead of creating a note. A naive merge that keeps this dispatcher as 'the' generic entry point silently breaks two of the five granularities.

observations.what: The 'try dev plugin id ("periodic-notes-anks"), then production id ("periodic-notes")' probe is implemented twice: once as the shared getPeriodicNotesPlugin() in settings.ts (used by settings.ts itself and by the monthly/quarterly/yearly plugin-detection functions), and once inlined separately inside appHasDailyNotesPluginLoaded and appHasWeeklyNotesPluginLoaded in index.ts, which do not call getPeriodicNotesPlugin() at all. The Calendar plugin's 'calendar-anks'/'calendar' probe (index.ts:38-39) is also unique to appHasWeeklyNotesPluginLoaded and not centralized anywhere.
observations.why_it_matters: A merge that only updates the shared getPeriodicNotesPlugin() helper (e.g. to add a third plugin id, or change probe order) will miss the two inlined copies in index.ts, silently leaving daily/weekly detection out of sync with monthly/quarterly/yearly.

observations.what: The {{date±N unit:format}}/{{time}} regex-and-callback used to fill in date/time template tokens is copy-pasted verbatim across createDailyNote, createWeeklyNote, createMonthlyNote, createQuarterlyNote, and createYearlyNote instead of being a shared helper.
observations.why_it_matters: A fix or extension to this token syntax (e.g. adding a new unit or fixing a formatting edge case) has to be applied identically in five places; the merge should extract this into one shared function up front rather than porting all five copies.

observations.what: getAllDailyNotes() does not call appHasDailyNotesPluginLoaded() before walking the vault, unlike getAllWeeklyNotes/getAllMonthlyNotes/getAllQuarterlyNotes/getAllYearlyNotes, which all return {} early if their respective plugin isn't enabled.
observations.why_it_matters: If daily notes are effectively 'disabled' but a folder still exists at the configured (possibly stale/default) path, getAllDailyNotes will still scan it and throw DailyNotesFolderMissingError only if the folder is truly absent — it never short-circuits the way the other four granularities do. A merge that unifies getAll*Notes into one generic function must decide whether to add the missing guard to daily or intentionally drop it from the others.

observations.what: allowPrefixMatch is declared generically on IPeriodicNoteSettings and consumed generically in parse.ts's getDateFromFilename for every granularity, but only getWeeklyNoteSettings ever populates it (and only from the Periodic Notes plugin path — the Calendar-plugin fallback hardcodes it to false). getDailyNoteSettings/getMonthlyNoteSettings/getQuarterlyNoteSettings/getYearlyNoteSettings never include the key at all.
observations.why_it_matters: Prefix/loose filename matching (e.g. matching '2026-01-15 Some Title.md' as a daily note) silently cannot work for day/month/quarter/year notes today, even though nothing in parse.ts's logic is week-specific. If the merge wants to offer prefix matching uniformly, each of the four other resolve-*-settings functions needs the same wiring added.

observations.what: Weekly-note detection (appHasWeeklyNotesPluginLoaded) treats the mere presence of the Calendar plugin as sufficient ('true' as soon as app.plugins.getPlugin('calendar-anks'||'calendar') returns truthy), without checking any 'weekly enabled' flag on it — whereas daily notes check internalPlugins...['daily-notes'].enabled, and monthly/quarterly/yearly check periodicNotes.settings[g].enabled. Weekly is the only granularity where plugin-installed implies feature-enabled.
observations.why_it_matters: A user who has the Calendar plugin installed but has turned off its weekly-notes feature (if such a toggle exists) will still be reported as 'weekly notes enabled' by this library — a behavior a unified implementation should decide to keep or fix explicitly, not inherit by accident.

observations.what: The repo-root index.d.ts (hand-maintained, not referenced by package.json's missing 'types' field, and not produced by the rollup build which only emits dist/main.js) is out of sync with src/: it declares DailyNotesFolderMissingError/WeeklyNotesFolderMissingError/MonthlyNotesFolderMissingError/QuarterlyNotesFolderMissingError/YearlyNotesFolderMissingError as top-level exports of the package, but src/index.ts never imports or re-exports any of the five *FolderMissingError classes from daily.ts/weekly.ts/monthly.ts/quarterly.ts/yearly.ts. It also declares IPeriodicNoteSettings without allowPrefixMatch, unlike src/types.ts.
observations.why_it_matters: Anyone consulting index.d.ts for 'what this library exports' (rather than reading src/index.ts) will believe the *FolderMissingError classes and a narrower settings shape are part of the public API; a merge should treat src/index.ts as the sole source of truth and either delete or regenerate index.d.ts.

observations.what: Despite the role hint that obsidian-periodic-notes 'historically' used this library, the checked-out obsidian-periodic-notes repo does not import 'obsidian-daily-notes-interface' anywhere and is not listed in its package.json dependencies; it instead ships its own independent parser.ts, cache.ts, calendarSetManager.ts, and settings/ implementing equivalent (but not necessarily identical) date-parsing and settings-resolution logic.
observations.why_it_matters: The merge cannot treat obsidian-daily-notes-interface as periodic-notes' current settings/parsing implementation — that logic has diverged into a second, independently-evolved copy that must be diffed against this one (parse.ts especially) rather than assumed compatible. This should be resolved by whichever agent maps obsidian-periodic-notes.

observations.what: getPeriodicNotesPlugin() is exported from settings.ts and imported into index.ts, but is not included in index.ts's final `export { ... }` block, so it is not part of the package's public API even though three of the five plugin-detection functions (monthly/quarterly/yearly) are effectively thin wrappers around it.
observations.why_it_matters: A consumer plugin cannot get the raw Periodic Notes plugin instance (e.g. to read settings for a custom granularity, or to react to its own onload) without reimplementing the dev/production id probe itself — worth deciding whether to make this a first-class public export in the merged library.

observations.what: weekly.ts, monthly.ts, quarterly.ts, and yearly.ts each import their corresponding appHasXNotesPluginLoaded function from './index' (the package's own aggregator module), creating an internal circular dependency (index.ts imports from these files' create/get functions, and they import back from index.ts for the plugin-detection function).
observations.why_it_matters: This works today because TypeScript/ES module circular imports of pure functions are tolerated, but a restructure during the merge (e.g. splitting index.ts differently, or bundling with stricter tooling) could break at the module-resolution level; the merge should relocate appHasXNotesPluginLoaded next to detect-periodic-notes-plugin in a settings/detection module instead of index.ts to remove the cycle.
